text:
Jasper - Support: @Olivia pulling your BYOK onboarding thread into support so sec/eng can validate. Acme wants customer-managed CMK (AWS) + rotation + audit retention. Key questions: 1) exact IAM principal(s) that will call GenerateDataKey/Decrypt? 2) are you doing key rotation by rewrap on our side or will you rotate and rewrap client-side? 3) need confirmation on CloudTrail setup for KMS events. Can you paste the role ARN and any existing key policy?

Olivia - Acme SRE: ARN: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/acme-redwood-agent. We plan to rotate CMK every 90 days. We prefer to perform rewrap ourselves but want Redwood to be able to fallback to re-encrypt if we hand off. Key policy is pretty standard, I'll paste minimal snippet: 

Olivia - Acme SRE: ```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {"Sid": "AllowAccountUse", "Effect": "Allow", "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:root"}, "Action": "kms:*", "Resource": "*" }
  ]
}
```

Priya Rao - SecEng: Thanks. A few points up front: 
- We require explicit least-privilege for the Redwood service principal. For envelope flow the minimal action set we need to support generation and decryption of data keys and rewrap fallbacks is typically: `kms:GenerateDataKey*`, `kms:Decrypt`, `kms:Encrypt`, `kms:ReEncryptFrom`, `kms:ReEncryptTo`, and `kms:CreateGrant` (if you use grants). `kms:DescribeKey` is also useful for diagnostics.
- For audit logging: CloudTrail must be configured to record KMS API activity in the same account as the CMK or centrally aggregated. We look for `GenerateDataKey`, `Decrypt`, `ReEncrypt*`, `CreateGrant`, `DisableKey`, `ScheduleKeyDeletion` events. Make sure CloudTrail is not filtering KMS events out.
- Rotation model: if you rotate client-side and do a full rewrap of stored DEKs, Redwood only needs to read the new ciphertext. If you rotate without rewrapping existing encrypted DEKs we need the ability to call `ReEncrypt` using the old->new key or you must provide a migration plan.

Kevin Liu - EngOps: Quick validation steps you can run and paste outputs: 
- Confirm CloudTrail logs for KMS: 
```bash
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventSource,AttributeValue=kms.amazonaws.com --max-results 5
```
- Validate that our role can call GenerateDataKey: 
```bash
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/acme-redwood-agent --role-session-name sanity-check
# then with assumed creds
aws kms generate-data-key --key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/EXAMPLE --key-spec AES_256 --query CiphertextBlob --output text | head -c 64 | base64 --decode >/dev/null || echo 'ok'
```
(we don't need actual plaintext here, just that the API returns a ciphertext blob)

Priya Rao - SecEng: Also a couple of policy gotchas we've seen: 
- If your key policy grants the account root full control but not the service principal explicitly, cross-account/grant operations can fail. We recommend adding an explicit Statement for the Redwood service principal ARN with those allowed actions.
- `kms:CreateGrant` is required when using temporary grants (e.g., to give ephemeral permissions to pods or cross-account). If you block CreateGrant then ReEncrypt-based migrations may not work in some fallback flows.

Olivia - Acme SRE: Noted. For Azure customers we also expect guidance, but this onboarding is AWS-first. One gap we hit in the docs: there isn't a clear checklist for verifying "re-encrypt compatibility" after rotation — can Redwood add a short validation section?

Jasper - Support: Good call. Priya/Kevin can we add a short checklist to docs (quick commands + required actions) for both AWS & Azure? Olivia, we'll add a sample rewrap plan to the onboarding checklist.

Priya Rao - SecEng: I'll draft a checklist item that includes: 
- Confirm role ARN(s) and add explicit policy statement for the Redwood principal.
- Verify CloudTrail captures KMS events (sample lookup command).
- Confirm ability to call `GenerateDataKey` and `Decrypt` via assume-role test.
- If you require customer-triggered rotation, confirm the rewrap process and whether you'll provide rotated ciphertexts or want Redwood to call `ReEncrypt` during migration.

Kevin Liu - EngOps: Added small sample AWS policy we suggest for the role (strip down to least privilege in prod): 
```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::543210987654:role/redwood-service"},
      "Action": ["kms:GenerateDataKey*", "kms:Decrypt", "kms:ReEncryptFrom", "kms:ReEncryptTo", "kms:DescribeKey", "kms:CreateGrant" ],
      "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/EXAMPLE"
    }
  ]
}
```

Priya Rao - SecEng: For Azure Key Vault (brief): grant the Redwood service principal the "Cryptographic Operations" (or the built-in "Key Vault Crypto Service Encryption User") role/permissions, ensure diagnostic logs are sent to a Log Analytics workspace or storage account and include key operation events, and confirm that vault soft-delete & purge-protection policies are compatible with your rotation plan.

kms-bot: New CloudTrail event detected for key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/EXAMPLE - GenerateDataKey - principal arn:aws:sts::543210987654:assumed-role/redwood-service/session-id - 2024-10-02T18:20:34Z

Olivia - Acme SRE: Paste of our run of the lookup: 
```
$ aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventSource,AttributeValue=kms.amazonaws.com --max-results 3
EventId: 1234-...
EventName: GenerateDataKey
EventTime: 2024-10-02T18:20:34Z
Principal: arn:aws:sts::543210987654:assumed-role/redwood-service/session-id
```

Jasper - Support: Perfect, that shows the service principal is calling GenerateDataKey. Action items: 
- Priya: add docs checklist + policy samples to onboarding guide (assigning to you).
- Kevin: add quick validation bash snippet to support runbook.
- Olivia: add confirmation whether you want Redwood to perform rewrap during rotation or if you'll supply rewrapped ciphertexts (answer please).

Olivia - Acme SRE: We'll do rotation + rewrap client-side for now, will reach out if we need Redwood fallback. Thanks all :thumbsup:
